- Data residency (US-only region) with 13-month retention
- HSM-backed KMS for key storage (estimated 6 HSM seats)

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Really appreciate the clarity on requirements. I pulled together two views: a straight line-item quote and a blended/concession option designed for predictable budgeting. High-level summary below; I attached a pricing workbook and a short SOW draft.

Line items (monthly list price estimates):
- Data residency (US) + 13-month retention: $3,200/month
- Audit logging export (1TB/month ingest; S3 export + retention ops): $1,800/month
- HSM-backed KMS: $1,250/seat/month (6 seats => $7,500/month)
- HIPAA onboarding fee (one-time): $5,000

Total list monthly: $12,500 (excl. taxes)

Blended / committed option (12-month committed spend):
- Residency + audit logs bundle: $4,400/month (10% bundle discount)
- HSM seat credit option: 1) Pay-per-seat at list, or 2) commit 6 HSM seats and receive a 20% monthly credit on seat charges for the first 6 months (applied as invoice credit), or 3) prepay 12 months and receive 30% credit applied up-front.
- Waive HIPAA onboarding fee with 12-month committed ARR > $150k

Notes / questions:
- Your PO timing (you mentioned July 6 review) — we prefer a 30-day PO; we can accept a 60-day PO with sales finance approval (may change rollout of credits).
- For audit logging retention beyond 2 years we budget as archival storage; longer retention impacts costs materially. Can you confirm expected retention and whether archive access frequency will be low?

Next steps: if the blended option looks reasonable I can run a formal quote and loop in legal for SOW/BAA redlines. See attached: redwood-compliance-addons-v1.pdf and pricing-workback-medflow.xlsx

Best,
